SELECT
    c.containregistry AS container_id,
    sd.tempstabidx AS stability_score,
    MAX(sd.tempmaxc) AS max_temp_breach_severity,
    dl.syshealth AS overall_status
FROM
    sensordata sd
JOIN
    container c ON sd.containlink = c.containregistry
JOIN
    datalogger dl ON c.containregistry = dl.containlog
GROUP BY
    c.containregistry, sd.tempstabidx, dl.syshealth
LIMIT 100;

458562e42dbddd1e54117119b2941aac0c867cb7.sql:
SELECT 
    c.containregistry AS container_id,
    (CASE 
        WHEN sd.tempnowc > sd.temptolc THEN 'High' 
        WHEN sd.tempnowc < -sd.temptolc THEN 'Low' 
        ELSE 'Normal' 
    END) AS temperature_breach_severity,
    sd.tempdevcount AS temperature_deviations,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT sd.alertkind) AS alert_types
FROM 
    sensordata AS sd
JOIN 
    container AS c ON sd.containlink = c.containregistry
GROUP BY 
    c.containregistry, temperature_breach_severity, sd.tempdevcount
ORDER BY 
    temperature_deviations DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    c.containregistry AS container_id,
    c.coolremainpct AS coolant_remaining_percentage,
    (c.coolmass / NULLIF(c.coolrefills, 0)) AS coolant_depletion_rate,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (c.coolmass / NULLIF(c.coolrefills, 0)) DESC) AS coolant_depletion_rank
FROM 
    container AS c
JOIN 
    regulatoryandmaintenance AS r
ON 
    c.containregistry = r.shipgov
WHERE 
    r.riskflag ILIKE '%critical%';

WITH MaintenanceDelays AS (
    SELECT 
        regmaintregistry AS EquipmentID,
        compscore AS ComplianceScore,
        maintdatenext - maintdatelast AS Delay,
        CASE WHEN maintdatenext < CURRENT_DATE THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsOverdue
    FROM 
        regulatoryandmaintenance
    WHERE 
        compscore IS NOT NULL
),
RankedDelays AS (
    SELECT 
        EquipmentID,
        ComplianceScore,
        Delay,
        IsOverdue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Delay DESC) AS DelayRank
    FROM 
        MaintenanceDelays
)
SELECT 
    EquipmentID,
    ComplianceScore,
    Delay,
    IsOverdue
FROM 
    RankedDelays
WHERE 
    DelayRank <= 5
ORDER BY 
    Delay DESC;

WITH RecentSensorReadings AS (
    SELECT 
        vehsenseref, 
        MAX(sensortrack) as recent_sensortrack
    FROM 
        sensordata
    GROUP BY 
        vehsenseref
),
TransportDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        ti.vehiclereg, 
        ti.shiptransit AS shipment_id, 
        sd.tempstabidx AS handling_quality_index, 
        sd.tempstabidx AS temperature_stability_score
    FROM 
        transportinfo ti
    JOIN 
        RecentSensorReadings rsr
    ON 
        ti.vehiclereg = rsr.vehsenseref
    JOIN 
        sensordata sd
    ON 
        rsr.vehsenseref = sd.vehsenseref 
    AND 
        rsr.recent_sensortrack = sd.sensortrack
)
SELECT 
    vehiclereg, 
    shipment_id, 
    handling_quality_index, 
    ROUND(CAST(temperature_stability_score AS NUMERIC), 2) AS temperature_stability_score
FROM 
    TransportDetails
ORDER BY 
    temperature_stability_score;

        t2.vehsenseref

WITH SensorMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        containlink,
        MAX(tempdevcount) AS max_tempdevcount,
        MAX(critevents) AS max_critevents,
        MAX(tempstabidx) AS max_tempstabidx,
        MAX(tempnowc) AS max_tempnowc
    FROM sensordata
    GROUP BY containlink
),
ContainerMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry,
        sm.max_tempdevcount,
        sm.max_critevents,
        sm.max_tempstabidx,
        c.coolremainpct,
        sm.max_tempnowc
    FROM container c
    LEFT JOIN SensorMetrics sm ON c.containregistry = sm.containlink
)

SELECT 
    cm.containregistry AS container_id,
    cm.max_tempstabidx AS max_temperature_stability_score,
    -- Assuming Container Risk Index is calculated based on critical events and temperature deviations
    (cm.max_critevents * 10 + cm.max_tempdevcount) AS container_risk_index,
    -- Assuming Risk Rank is based on the Container Risk Index
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (cm.max_critevents * 10 + cm.max_tempdevcount) DESC) AS risk_rank,
    -- Assuming sensor data status is based on the presence of critical events
    CASE WHEN cm.max_critevents > 0 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Normal' END AS sensor_data_status,
    -- Diagnostic JSON summary
    json_build_object(
        'TempDevCount', cm.max_tempdevcount,
        'CritEvents', cm.max_critevents,
        'TempStabIdx', cm.max_tempstabidx,
        'CoolRemainPct', cm.coolremainpct,
        -- Assuming Temperature Breach Severity is based on max_tempnowc
        'TempBreachSeverity', CASE WHEN cm.max_tempnowc > 0 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END
    ) AS diagnostic_summary
FROM ContainerMetrics cm
ORDER BY risk_rank
LIMIT 10;

d446ae2ef7062924c5bb8317d59a66323de17c1f.sql:
WITH SensorMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.containlink, 
        MAX(sd.tempdevcount) AS max_tempdevcount, 
        MAX(sd.critevents) AS max_critevents, 
        MAX(sd.tempstabidx) AS max_tempstabidx, 
        -- Assuming 'alertkind' contains status information
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sd.alertkind, ', ') AS sensor_data_status
    FROM 
        sensordata sd
    GROUP BY 
        sd.containlink
),
ContainerMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry, 
        c.coolremainpct, 
        -- Assuming 'coolremainpct' is the coolant percentage remaining
        sm.max_tempdevcount, 
        sm.max_critevents, 
        sm.max_tempstabidx, 
        sm.sensor_data_status
    FROM 
        container c
    LEFT JOIN 
        SensorMetrics sm ON c.containregistry = sm.containlink
),
RiskMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.containregistry, 
        cm.coolremainpct, 
        cm.max_tempdevcount, 
        cm.max_critevents, 
        cm.max_tempstabidx, 
        cm.sensor_data_status, 
        -- Assuming 'Container Risk Index (CRI)' is calculated based on available data
        (cm.max_tempdevcount + cm.max_critevents) AS cri, 
        -- Assuming 'Temperature Breach Severity (TBS)' is calculated based on available data
        (cm.max_tempdevcount * cm.max_critevents) AS tbs, 
        -- Assuming 'Risk Rank' is calculated based on available data
        (cm.max_tempdevcount + cm.max_critevents + cm.max_tempstabidx) AS risk_rank
    FROM 
        ContainerMetrics cm
),
FinalResults AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.containregistry AS container_id, 
        rm.max_tempstabidx AS max_temp_stability_score, 
        rm.cri AS container_risk_index, 
        rm.risk_rank, 
        rm.sensor_data_status, 
        JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'TempDevCount', rm.max_tempdevcount,
            'CritEvents', rm.max_critevents,
            'TempStabIdx', rm.max_tempstabidx,
            'CoolRemainPct', rm.coolremainpct,
            'TempBreachSeverity', rm.tbs
        ) AS diagnostic_summary
    FROM 
        RiskMetrics rm
)
SELECT 
    container_id, 
    max_temp_stability_score, 
    container_risk_index, 
    risk_rank, 
    sensor_data_status, 
    diagnostic_summary
FROM 
    FinalResults
ORDER BY 
    risk_rank DESC
LIMIT 10;

        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        0 AS risk_rank,
        dl.logflag AS sensor_data_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(sd.tempstabidx) DESC) AS row_num
    FROM 
        Container c
    JOIN 
        SensorData sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
    JOIN 
        DataLogger dl ON c.containregistry = dl.containlog
    GROUP BY 
        c.containregistry, dl.logflag
)
SELECT 
    container_id,
    max_temp_stability_score,
    container_risk_index,
    risk_rank,
    sensor_data_status,
    json_build_object(
        'TempDevCount', MAX(sd.tempdevcount),
        'CritEvents', MAX(sd.critevents),
        'TempStabIdx', MAX(sd.tempstabidx),
        'CoolRemainPct', c.coolremainpct,
        -- Assuming Temperature Breach Severity (TBS) is an external knowledge and not directly in the database
        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        'TempBreachSeverity', 0
    ) AS diagnostic_summary
FROM 
    ranked_containers rc
JOIN 
    Container c ON rc.container_id = c.containregistry
JOIN 
    SensorData sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
WHERE 
    rc.row_num <= 10
GROUP BY 
    rc.container_id, rc.max_temp_stability_score, rc.container_risk_index, rc.risk_rank, rc.sensor_data_status, c.coolremainpct
ORDER BY 
    risk_rank;

WITH recent_sensor_readings AS (
    SELECT 
        vehsenseref AS vehicle_id,
        sensortrack,
        tempstabidx AS tss,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY vehsenseref ORDER BY sensortrack DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        sensordata
)

SELECT 
    r.vehicle_id,
    t.shiptransit AS shipment_id,
    -- Handling Quality Index column not found in database
    r.tss
FROM 
    recent_sensor_readings r
JOIN 
    transportinfo t ON r.vehicle_id = t.vehiclereg
WHERE 
    r.rn = 1
ORDER BY 
    r.tss;

WITH sensor_data_with_risk_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        T2.containregistry AS container_id,
        T1.tempstabidx AS max_temp_stability_score,
        (1 - T1.tempstabidx) * (1 - T2.coolremainpct/100) AS container_risk_index,
        ABS(T1.tempnowc - T1.storetempc)/T1.temptolc * T1.tempdevcount AS temp_breach_severity,
        T1.tempdevcount AS max_temp_deviation_count,
        T1.critevents AS max_critical_events,
        T2.coolremainpct AS current_coolant_percentage_remaining,
        T1.tempmaxc AS max_temp_stability_index,
        T1.containlink
    FROM 
        sensordata AS T1
    JOIN 
        container AS T2 ON T1.containlink = T2.containregistry
),
container_risk_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY container_risk_index DESC) AS risk_rank
    FROM 
        sensor_data_with_risk_metrics
)
SELECT 
    container_id,
    max_temp_stability_score,
    container_risk_index,
    risk_rank,
    JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'TempDevCount', max_temp_deviation_count,
        'CritEvents', max_critical_events,
        'TempStabIdx', max_temp_stability_index,
        'CoolRemainPct', current_coolant_percentage_remaining,
        'TempBreachSeverity', temp_breach_severity
    ) AS diagnostic_summary
FROM 
    container_risk_ranking
WHERE 
    risk_rank <= 10;
